verseText: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
meaning: Paul wrote these words. He experienced both good times and bad. But he trusted Christ Jesus to give him strength to face every situation and do what God called him to do.

meaning.question: Paul trusted Jesus whether he had plenty or very little. What kind of strength is this verse about?
choices: Strength to trust God in every situation
Strength to make life go our way

application.prompt: Paul faced hard days, and Jesus gave him strength to keep trusting Him. Think of something difficult you are facing. What could it look like to ask Jesus for strength and trust Him, even if the situation stays hard?
